ORIGINAL_REQUIREMENT.title: Open SQL null predicate
ORIGINAL_REQUIREMENT.sapRequirement: Target release/compiler, real dependencies, activation and relevant SAP runtime tests.

ABAP_SYNTAX_ASSESSMENT: Recognizable IS NULL predicate accepted locally; no SAP compiler.
SAP_MODELING_ASSESSMENT: DDIC XML has no explicit NULL/initial flag. Adapter bypasses physical SAP activation and creates nullable SQLite INTEGER.
TEST_ORACLE_ASSESSMENT: Injected NULL count 1 is valid locally. Replacing only NULL with zero changes count to 0. NOT NULL schema rejects original seed before ABAP executes.
ADDITIONAL_DEFECTS: SAP column lifecycle/nullability unverified. Null predicate is not a test of ABAP initial numeric values.

AUTHORITATIVE_REFERENCE.assessment: NULL differs from ABAP initial; outer joins can produce NULL; transfer without indicators can yield type-initial values.
